scores.label: A
scores.note: evaluate/assess/rate/rank usable but lose the negative sense of judging; size up is casual. 0s: 5 'measure each other' odd in place; 7 distinguish and 8 tell apart mean differentiate, wrong sense; 9 'pick on' changes judging to bullying and is casual; 10 'single out each other' is awkward and a different meaning.

scores.label: B
scores.note: evaluate/assess/rate/compare usable but neutral. 0s: 3 'evaluate based on' duplicates 'based on', ungrammatical in place; 4 'determine each other' wrong sense; 7 differentiate and 8 distinguish mean tell apart, wrong sense; 9 and 10 repeat 'each other', ungrammatical in place.
